output_semantics.coordinate_identity: the 131 exact uppercase ATC4 codes in vocabulary.json, in frozen canonical order
output_semantics.code_semantics: ATC4 identity after uppercase normalization; source native ATC4 field follows the documented [:4] projection where applicable
output_semantics.target_projection: retain native target tokens whose normalized identity is in the canonical 131 list; deduplicate and order by canonical vocabulary
output_semantics.zero_support_policy: retain coordinates in the 131 output space and AP/PRAUC; predicting one is a false positive
output_semantics.target_oov: native target OOV is rejected before projection; dropped native-only coordinates are counted as projection loss
output_semantics.empty_projected_target: exclude from recommendation examples, retain the underlying visit in chronology and history, report every exclusion
output_semantics.ddi_alignment: canonical 131 medication row order with 448 undirected source pairs; no inferred pairs

input_semantics.historical_medication_projection: yes; native-only medication identities are removed from prior-visit medication history
input_semantics.native173_only_history_medications: cannot appear in common131 history after projection
input_semantics.diagnosis_inputs: unchanged from the native Train-fitted diagnosis vocabulary, including explicit unknown handling on Dev
input_semantics.procedure_inputs: unchanged from the native Train-fitted procedure vocabulary, including explicit unknown handling on Dev
input_semantics.medication_graph_universe: canonical 131 for the common surface; DDI rows follow canonical order
input_semantics.molecular_graph_universe: canonical 131 medication rows; MoleRec/SafeDrug method-local BRICS columns remain distinct
input_semantics.train_only_statistics: diagnosis/procedure serializers are Train-fitted; the canonical medication list and molecular/DDI assets are frozen source assets, not target-frequency fits

population_effects.interpretation: the common surface changes evaluated visit/patient membership and target cardinality, so differences are not attributable to output width alone

native_vs_common.patients: full split membership is inherited, but evaluated patients decrease when all projected targets for a patient are empty
native_vs_common.visits: recommendation examples decrease from 308824 to 308474 in Train and from 76529 to 76443 in Dev; chronology retains source visits
native_vs_common.targets: native 173-token targets are projected to canonical 131 and native-only tokens are dropped
native_vs_common.history_inputs: diagnoses/procedures are unchanged; historical medication sets are projected to canonical 131
native_vs_common.target_cardinality: mean falls from 14.595960816 to 11.104253583 in Train and from 14.603575146 to 11.111578643 in Dev
native_vs_common.ddi_universe: native surface uses a 173x173 projection with 443 pairs; common surface uses canonical 131x131 with 448 pairs and two explicit zero-support coordinates

limitations: exact cohort/preprocessing identity with every named literature benchmark remains unresolved
common-131 and native-173 are target-space views of the same MIMIC-IV population, not independent datasets
this audit does not authorize Test loading or paper-candidate language
